The '''Senatorial Accounts Presidium''' was a location in the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], associated with the protection of [[Senator/Legends|senator]]ial accounts and overseeing the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] expenses.
